finding.message: src/session.mjs isSessionValid compares age against SESSION_LIFETIME * 1000 * 1000. SESSION_LIFETIME is already in seconds (30*60), so the window is 1,800,000,000 ms (about 500 hours) rather than 1,800,000 ms (30 minutes). Sessions stay valid about 1000 times too long. Fix: use SESSION_LIFETIME * 1000, so that age < 1800000 ms is valid and age >= 1800000 ms is not.
